intro: Somalia is mostly dry plains and plateaus, with mountains in the north and two rivers in the south.

chapters.title: Land
text: The Juba and Shabelle rivers water farmland in the south. The north has the Cal Madow mountains. The coast faces the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean.

chapters.title: Droughts
text: Repeated droughts have killed livestock and caused famine, made worse by climate change.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Somalia's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
